  {Ω₂ : Type u_2} {Ω₃ : Type u_3} {Ω₄ : Type u_4} [mΩ₁ : MeasurableSpace Ω₁] [mΩ₂ : MeasurableSpace Ω₂]
  [mΩ₃ : MeasurableSpace Ω₃] [mΩ₄ : MeasurableSpace Ω₄] {X₁ : Ω₁ → α} {X₂ : Ω₂ → α} {X₃ : Ω₃ → α} {X₄ : Ω₄ → α}
  (hX₁ : Measurable X₁) (hX₂ : Measurable X₂) (hX₃ : Measurable X₃) (hX₄ : Measurable X₄) (μ₁ : Measure Ω₁)
  (μ₂ : Measure Ω₂) (μ₃ : Measure Ω₃) (μ₄ : Measure Ω₄) [hμ₁ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ₁] [hμ₂ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ₂]
  [hμ₃ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ₃] [hμ₄ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ₄] :
  let Ω₁' := ULift.{max u_2 u_3 u_4, u_1} Ω₁;
  let Ω₂' := ULift.{max u_1 u_3 u_4, u_2} Ω₂;
  let Ω₃' := ULift.{max u_1 u_2 u_4, u_3} Ω₃;
  let Ω₄' := ULift.{max u_1 u_2 u_3, u_4} Ω₄;
  let Ω := ![Ω₁', Ω₂', Ω₃', Ω₄'];
  let mΩ := fun i =>
    Fin.cases inferInstance
      (fun i =>
        Fin.cases inferInstance (fun i => Fin.cases inferInstance (fun i => Fin.cases inferInstance Fin.rec0 i) i) i)
      i;
  let X := fun i =>
    Fin.cases (motive := fun x => Ω x → α) (X₁ ∘ ULift.down)
      (fun i =>
        Fin.cases (motive := fun x => Ω x.succ → α) (X₂ ∘ ULift.down)
          (fun i =>
            Fin.cases (motive := fun x => Ω x.succ.succ → α) (X₃ ∘ ULift.down)
              (fun i => Fin.cases (motive := fun x => Ω x.succ.succ.succ → α) (X₄ ∘ ULift.down) Fin.rec0 i) i)
          i)
      i;
  (∀ (i : Fin 4), Measurable (X i)) →
    let μ := fun i =>
      Fin.cases (Measure.comap ULift.down μ₁)
        (fun i =>
          Fin.cases (Measure.comap ULift.down μ₂)
            (fun i =>
              Fin.cases (Measure.comap ULift.down μ₃) (fun i => Fin.cases (Measure.comap ULift.down μ₄) Fin.rec0 i) i)
            i)
        i;
    let hμ_1 := ⋯;
    ∀ (A : Type (max (max (max u_1 u_2) u_3) u_4)) (mA : MeasurableSpace A) (μA : Measure A) (X' : Fin 4 → A → α),
      IsProbabilityMeasure μA →
        iIndepFun (fun i => mS) X' μA →
          (∀ (i : Fin 4), Measurable (X' i) ∧ IdentDistrib (X' i) (X i) μA (μ i)) →
            ∀ (x : A), ![X' 0, X' 1, X' 2, X' 3] ((fun i => i) ⟨2, ⋯⟩) x = X' ((fun i => i) ⟨2, ⋯⟩) x := by
  rfl

theorem image_preimage_eq {f : α → β} (s : Set β) (h : Surjective f) : f '' (f ⁻¹' s) = s :=
